title: Living alone
instructions: Clara ilk kez yalnız yaşamayı anlatıyor. İyi ve kötü yanlara dikkat et.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: Six months ago, I moved out of my parents' house.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: Now I live alone in a small flat near my university.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: I love it because I can do what I want. I listen to music, and nobody tells me to turn it down!

script.speaker: clara
script.text: But some things are harder. I have to cook, clean and wash my clothes.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: I'm not a good cook, so I often eat pasta.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: I call my mum every evening, and I visit my parents once a month.

questions.feedback: Üniversitesinin yakınında küçük bir dairede yalnız yaşıyor.
questions.evidence: Now I live alone in a small flat near my university.

questions.feedback: İyi yemek yapamadığı için sık sık makarna yiyor.

questions.prompt: How often does Clara visit her parents?
questions.feedback: Annesini her akşam arıyor; ailesini ayda bir (once a month) ziyaret ediyor.
questions.evidence: I visit my parents once a month.
